_note: Walking demo biome catalog (alpine single-biome). Spec 22. Per-slot selectors drive per-fragment slot weight in the shader (spec 23 §Surface slot model). Elevation bands tuned to the NoiseStackKernel amplitude=50 m so all three slots are exercised on the visible terrain.

selector._note: Low / flat terrain — alpine firn snow basin. Phase 4.11.b: widened slope window to 0..25 with a tight 3deg band so flat snow stays pure ground (no mid bleed).
Mid slopes — lichen + moss on transitional rock. Phase 4.11.b: raised slope start to 25deg so mid only activates on real slopes; tightened bands to reduce bleed on near-flat ground.
High / steep — granite + lichen on exposed bedrock.
